title: Capsule speaker in the model village

tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph, edge to edge, no border. The capsule speaker lies in the grass of the lawn at the very edge of the model village, at its true size beside a daisy, while a model steam train crosses the little stone bridge just behind it and the knee-high cottages and church spire stand beyond; nothing of the speaker stands in the village lanes or squares. Low evening sun. 85mm from grass level, the speaker large and sharp, the village soft behind.
